questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “He is addicted ____ gambling.”
Choose the correct phrasal verb: “The officer promised to ______ the complaint.”
questions.why: Look into = investigate. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the error: “Despite of the heavy rain, the match continued.”
questions.why: 'Despite' is never followed by 'of'; 'in spite of' or 'despite'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Change into a compound sentence: “Though he is poor, he is honest.”
opts: He is poor, so he is honest.
He is poor, but he is honest.
He is poor, for he is honest.
He is poor, or he is honest.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive construction: “Where did you buy this book?”
opts: Where this book was bought by you?
Where is this book bought by you?
Where did this book bought by you?
Where was this book bought by you?
questions.why: Past simple question becomes 'was + subject + past participle'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct conjunction: “Take an umbrella lest it ____.”
questions.why: 'Lest' is followed by 'should' + base verb. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: “a disease that spreads over a whole country or the world”
questions.why: Epidemic = widespread in one community at a time; endemic = regularly found in an area. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct modal: “You ______ not park here; it is a no-parking zone.”
Choose the correct tense: “I ____ you for ages; where have you been?”
questions.why: 'For ages' (up to now) takes the present perfect. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive construction: “Open the window.”
questions.why: Imperative passive: Let + object + be + past participle. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
